summary: This page presents the Corporate Profile of United Hampshire US REIT (UHREIT), detailing its portfolio composition as of 31 December 2025 with 20 Grocery & Necessity and two Self-Storage properties valued at US$774.3 million across an aggregate Net Lettable Area of 3.6 million square feet, and identifies UOB Global Capital LLC and The Hampshire Companies, LLC as joint sponsors via their respective subsidiaries.

This page presents the 2025 financial highlights for SGX REIT, featuring key metrics in US$ million including Gross Revenue of US$72.0 million, Net Property Income of US$49.0 million, and Appraised Value of US$774.3 million. Each metric is accompanied by a bar chart displaying historical data from 2021 to 2025 and includes comparative year-over-year changes versus FY2024.

It reports portfolio valuation growth of 3.8% to an AUM of US$774.3 million as at 31 December 2025, with gross revenue and net property income decreasing 1.7% year-on-year due to divestments but excluding these impacts showing increases of 2.3% and 4.1% respectively.
